fact: Regulation 13 of the PFM Regulations 2019 makes GIFMIS the core platform for processing government financial transactions, and the Auditor-General found for 2024 that covered entities did not fully process transactions through GIFMIS, so the Controller and Accountant-General journalised manual data into it and was urged to upgrade GIFMIS.
title: Report of the Auditor-General on the Public Accounts of Ghana (Whole-of-Government Accounts) for the year ended 31 December 2024
publisher: Office of the Auditor-General, Ghana Audit Service
